notes.title: August Update! Online Features, Flowers & More
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I'm super excited to bring the next big update for Small Spaces to you with the first ever online features, atmospheric rain, new balcony items, plants and flowers 🌺[/p][p][/p][h3]Online Features:[/h3][p]Small Spaces is a community game. Yet, so far the community was mostly happening on our [url="https://discord.gg/TH4qT3nQmu"]Discord[/url]. With the new update you can upload your designs for everyone else to find and visit. I'm super excited to look at all your designs there and hope it can be a source of inspiration for your own![/p][p]As this is the first online feature, I'd love to hear your feedback, thoughts and ideas on this step :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/46e52e8be8ff902b6505f4e133b54738e88a9e0e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What else is new?[/h3][p]🌧️ Let it rain! Now occasionally it may start to rain for some extra cozy atmosphere. Can be turned off in the settings though if you prefer it sunny![/p][p]☀ 30+ new balcony items with it's own new category![/p][p]🪴 A new plant expansion with more variety and finally some hanging plants![/p][p]🌸 Flower expansion with 20+ flowers and even some loose flowers that you can out into vases yourself![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/d8d7ac0652d756e0a417aa1b111a336f15eff464.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What's coming next?[/h3][p]One thing I hear from players all the time is that they want more clutter. Well, I hear you! The new balcony items are just the beginning and we plan to add 150 more within the next two months![/p][p]Additionally we're gonna continue to work hard on the creative mode in which you can design your own apartment layouts. Planned to come this fall![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for playing. I really hope you're gonna enjoy the update and I'm super excited for your feedback♥️[/p][p][/p][p]-Niklas[/p]

notes.title: Bugfixes & Cheatcode
notes.notes:
For some players who downloaded the tiny house update right after it was first launched, their module packs got removed and have to be rebought. I added a cheatcode for that in this update. Use it wisely <3

[list]
[*] bugfix for ceiling lights to work in tokyo levels
[*] bugfix for 2nd floor to always work (some players encountered issues)
[*] splitted tiny house corners into separate meshes to be used with materials
[*] added keyboard instrument
[*] cheatcode to add 5 stars - Press Shift+Enter when in the menu
[/list]

notes.title: Container Tiny Houses Update (and much more!)
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]
I’m super excited to announce that it’s time for the [b]first big update[/b] since the Early Access launch![/p][p]And just in time — [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] just started! If you haven’t picked up [i]Small Spaces[/i] yet, now’s your chance to grab it at [b]20% off[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/35c3c4e222417dc60d520a896735ae1b8fd6bfbf.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What’s New?[/h2][p][/p][p]The update brings a ton of new features and improvements:[/p][p]✨ [b]The new tiny container home theme with[/b] [b]3 all new levels[/b]
🪑 [b]40+ new furniture pieces[/b] for your tiny houses, terraces, yoga area and music instruments
🧩 [b]New module pack[/b] – including kitchen cabinets (some more items will follow!)

🎮 [b]New keybind system
👾 Bugfixes and small improvements[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/b71f2c1cf0eb5a721f0f0f0471040c7ffa0caa15.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I hope you enjoy building with these new cozy container houses, and all the other new features! As always, I’d love to hear your thoughts — I’m constantly working to improve and expand the game based on your feedback 💛[/p][p][/p][h2]🛠 What’s Next?[/h2][p][/p][p]Check out the roadmap for a sneak peek at what’s coming. Next, we’ll be adding many more decorative assets, and strongly focus on Sandbox Mode — where you’ll be able to freely design your own apartment layouts and take the creative possibilities in [i]Small Spaces[/i] to a whole new level![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157920/cd9e30ea42504e6866117397065c319ead73fc64.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As always, thank you so much for playing. Can't wait to see what you'll create with the new update [b]<3[/b][/p][p]— Niklas[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3151380/Small_Spaces/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Demo Update for Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
I’m excited to share some news! Small Spaces is taking part in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! 🎉

To celebrate, I’ve released a new demo update with fresh content and improvements. If you haven’t checked it out yet, now is a great time to jump in.

[h3]What’s New in the Demo?[/h3]

🔹 Tokyo Level Rework
🔹 New Level Selection
🔹 Two New Levels – one for Tokyo and one for Berlin
🔹 Lots of smaller improvements and bugfixes

Just a small note: This update might cause some save games to stop working. Very sorry for that. It’s just caused by technical changes during the ongoing development. 

Huge thanks to everyone for playing and for all the demo reviews! Don’t forget to share your thoughts – I’d love to hear what you think.

Enjoy Steam Next Fest! ✨

See you soon,
Niklas

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3332940/Small_Spaces_Demo/

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.notes:
It’s been one month since the release of the Small Spaces demo and I am so excited about all the wonderful designs you’ve created and shared in the [url=https://discord.gg/sBHb88EB6v]Small Spaces Discord[/url]!

To this day over 40,000 (!!!) people have played the Small Spaces demo and I am so excited you’ve been enjoying the game.

I’m taking all the feedback to heart and will now continue to work on the game to release it some time next year! (more details coming soon)

But before all that, I want to leave you with a small thank you - the Christmas update!

The Christmas update brings a tree, presents and other decorations to the game! I recommend to put your favorite Christmas music on and get cozy decorating a beautiful Christmas home <3

Enjoy the holidays and merry Christmas!
